name: amphetamine-quick
title: Amphetamine Quick
description: Start, end, and check Amphetamine keep-awake sessions by typing the duration as command arguments
author: ceyhuncicek

commands.name: start-session
commands.title: Start Session
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Start a keep-awake session for the entered duration. Leave all three boxes empty for a session with no time limit.

preferences.name: displaySleepAllowed
preferences.title: Display
preferences.label: Allow the display to sleep during a session
preferences.description: When on, the screen may sleep while the session keeps the system awake.

commands.name: show-status
commands.title: Show Status
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Show whether a session is active and the time remaining.
